dedupe_keys.name: pathfinder thunderhead engineering crowd movement and egress simulation

description: Pathfinder is a commercial crowd movement simulation and egress program from Thunderhead Engineering for modelling people entering, moving through and leaving indoor and outdoor environments. Each simulated pedestrian adapts to its surroundings, reacting to door availability, environmental cues, signage and alerts. The provider lists four applications: entry and queueing at ticket booths, checkpoints and doorways; pedestrian circulation with grouping and dynamic actions; reactions to emergencies, including evacuation, assisted evacuation, spread of threat awareness and exposure to fire conditions; and structured egress analyses for code compliance. The 2026.2 release adds simplified CAD import, section boxes and results measurement regions. The provider publishes its own validation tests, offers a Python-based scripting toolkit to run them or build suitability data, and supports several scenarios per file and sensitivity analysis of random initial conditions. Coverage: any building or site the user models. Access: download from the provider with a fully featured 30-day trial. Licence: commercial, with published pricing. Caveats: closed source, so the movement algorithms can only be checked against the provider's published tests. Simulation uses are building evacuation and assisted evacuation of critical facilities, and crowd flow in stations and venues. Related records: the UFRGS evacuation drill data, which compares a drill with Pathfinder, and the MassMotion record.
